topics.title: Jardiance (Empagliflozin) PAC Studies – HFrEF & HFpEF License Renewal and HA Interaction with CDE

background.text: ONI feasibility report delayed; TA to collaborate with RA to assess available ONIS study data for Jardiance license renewal in 2026 and develop HA communication strategy for CEC review. Action completed 2024-12-19.
background.quote: TA to collaborate with RA to assess the available data from the ONIS study for Jardiance license renew in 2026, and develop a HA communication strategy for CEC review

background.text: Risk assessment on license renewal reported to MAP and MBR; HA communication strategy and mitigation plan aligned by CRM CEC.
background.quote:
Risk assessment on license renewal has been reported to MAP and MBR.
HA communication strategy and mitigation plan has been aligned by CRM CEC.

background.text: MAP action (2024-12-12, due 2024-12-20, owner: Jardiance evidence team): (1) collect LTF 2025-2029 for Empa HFrEF & HFpEF; (2) prepare official communication letter to CDE on PAC study challenges for Dr. Zhang review; (3) kick off formal HA interaction preparation concurrently with PI feasibility report expected March 2025. All completed by 2024-12-31.
background.quote:
1. Collect the information of LTF(2025-2029) for Empa HFrEF & HFpEF for team scenario evaluation.
2. Prepare a draft of  official communication letter to CDE, introducing the current situation and challenges for Jardiance PAC study and seeking CDE’s opinion. Forward the draft to Dr. Zhang for review.
3. Kick off the preparation of formal health authority interaction with CDE, concurrently expecting feasibility report from PI in March 2025.

background.text: LTF collected; HA communication letter finalized after internal and PI review; HA interaction slides deck and meeting request to be submitted before Chinese New Year Holiday; communication objective (extending final report to next license renewal round, with interim period report mitigation plan) aligned in CEC.
background.quote: HA interaction slides deck and meeting request to be submitted before Chinese New Year Holiday. The communication objective for the requirement on extending final report to the next round of license renewal, along with the mitigation plan for submitting the interim period report within the upcoming license review timeframe has been aligned in CEC.
